title: BISSELL Expands Recall of Cordless Multi-Surface Wet Dry Vacuums Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The circuit board inside the vacuum's battery pack can overheat and smoke, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,000 (About 56,000 BISSELL® Cordless Multi-Surface Wet Dry Vacuums Models 2551, 2551W and 25519 were previously recalled in January 2023).

title: IKEA Recalls BLÅVINGAD Fishing Games Due to Choking Hazard
summary: A small metal rivet within a wooden play piece can come loose and detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 25,000 (In addition, about 2,200 were sold in Canada).

title: Mammut Sports Group Recalls Alugator Ride 3.0 Hoe and Alugator Ride SE Avalanche Shovels Due to Risk of Injury or Death
summary: The spring locking mechanism on the recalled avalanche shovels can fail in an emergency excavation of a person buried by an avalanche, posing a risk of injury or death for the buried person. Units: About 5,580 (In addition, about 1,964 were sold in Canada).

title: Monti Kids Recalls Basket with Balls Toys Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The swirls sewn onto the exterior of the blue crocheted ball can separate, exposing small parts, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,700.

title: Bagno Milano Recalls Children's Robes Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The children's robes fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 3,600.

title: DynaDrive Fresh Water Well Pumps Recalled Due to Risk of Electric Shock; Manufactured by Davey Water Products
summary: The pumps are not adequately grounded and can pose an electric shock hazard to the user. Units: About 1,060.

title: Lil Anglers Recalls Children's Fishing Rods Sold with Kid Casters No Tangle Combos Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban
summary: The fishing rods contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 78,500 (In addition, about 2,250 sold in Canada).

title: Lucky Global Recalls Lelinta Multi-Purpose Kids Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury; Sold Exclusively on Walmart.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the positional stability requirements of the CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect a child in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 30.

summary: The necklaces have high levels of cadmium. Cadmium is toxic if ingested by children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 4,300.
